complete-description:
Keep an eye on the time where you are and where the people you care about are.

Pick how many clocks you want. A single clock shows one time, either this machine's own or a place you choose. A dual clock shows two places side by side, handy for keeping up with family in another country. A multi clock shows up to four. Each widget is named after the place it shows, so a single clock for Dhaka is simply called Dhaka, a dual clock is called "Regina | Dhaka", and a multi clock is called Clock. You can always type your own name instead.

The clocks keep ticking on their own between updates, and daylight saving is handled for you. How the time looks (12 or 24 hour, with or without seconds) is up to the theme you use.

What it needs from you: nothing for this machine's own time. For another place, choose "A location" and search for a city. The first time it shows a new place, it asks Open-Meteo, a free service, which time zone that place is in, and then remembers it for a day.
